[[File:VB1-L-precisehit-pre.gif|thumb|right|250px|[[Precise Hit (V)]]: the PC card image prints the 2009 text.]]
'''Players Committee transcription errors''' are mistakes in the card text that the [[Players Committee]] (PC) published or kept for its [[Virtual Legacy]] cards (2009&ndash;2014): a document that printed an older text after a newer one had been published, card data that gave a card the text of a different card, release sheets re-made with later errata but still carrying their first date, and smaller slips and typos. Because the PC published the same card in several documents, these errors explain why a card article on this wiki, the card in [[GEMP]] and a given PC document sometimes show different text for the same card. The wider history of how Legacy text was copied between documents, and how this wiki counts versions, is in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].

== The documents involved ==
The PC put Legacy card text in five kinds of document: the release sheets of each [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Block]] (PDFs marked "Official text as of" a date), errata posts, the card list on the PC website (with game text from 2012 to early 2013), the Virtual Cards Master List ("official text as of April 27, 2013") and the PC card images. Behind them sat card data that the PC did not call official: the [[Holotable]] data files and, later, the PC's JSON card data, from which GEMP and other tools take their text. The table of documents, with dates, is in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History#The documents|the history article]].

== The Master List prints older text ==
The Players Committee’s Virtual Cards Master List is labelled “official text as of April 27, 2013”.<ref name="ml">Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List, [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Light Side]] and [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Dark Side]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Current official files: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Light Side] and [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Dark Side]. Preserved copies: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive (Light Side)], [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive (Dark Side)]</ref> The Master List and the archived website card lists preserve different wording for cards such as [[Precise Hit (V)]].<ref name="cl">Players Committee website card lists, for example [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html VBlock1Type] (Internet Archive, 21 July 2012) and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121213050628/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Name.html VBlock1Name] (Internet Archive, 13 December 2012). From [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313220753/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 13 March 2013] the lists give only names and image links.</ref>

[[Precise Hit (V)]] is an example. The [[Virtual Block 1]] sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009) reads "LOST: Cancel Heroic (and any immunity to attrition) on a character or starship this turn."<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=11 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 11, slip 160. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref> By 21 July 2012 the card list had "may place target" in the USED half and "LOST: Target a Heroic character or starship. It loses Heroic and/or immunity to attrition, if any, this turn."<ref name="cl" /> The PC card image and the Master List print the 2009 words again.<ref name="ml" />

Each published text is documented as a separate version. The versions of Precise Hit (V) are [[Precise Hit (V)]] (sheet), [[Precise Hit (V) (Errata)]] (card list), [[Precise Hit (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC card image) and [[Precise Hit (V) (Errata 3)]] (Master List, current).<ref name="vb1" /><ref name="cl" /><ref name="ml" />

== Card data with another card's text ==
The PC's JSON card data for Legacy cards gives several cards the text of a different card. The 2012 card list, the release sheets, the Master List and the card images all have the real text. The 2010 Holotable data has the right text for all of these cards,<ref name="cdf">Holotable card data, version 20100529: [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/darkside.cdf darkside.cdf] and [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf lightside.cdf] (committed 13 July 2010)</ref> so the wrong texts entered the data later. They were already there when the PC moved its Legacy cards into their own files on 11 March 2021.<ref name="json2021">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/f42eed0ffa9722adfbb469d7707d31947c9cfd54/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] and [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/f42eed0ffa9722adfbb469d7707d31947c9cfd54/LightLegacy.json LightLegacy.json] at commit f42eed0 ("Pulled legacy cards out into their own Light/Dark-legacy.json files", 11 March 2021)</ref> In the copies examined in November 2026 they were still there.<ref name="json2026">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/65cd150d20634447a5499d763ac324436158c7a8/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] and [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/65cd150d20634447a5499d763ac324436158c7a8/LightLegacy.json LightLegacy.json] at commit 65cd150 (21 October 2026)</ref>

== Text found only in card data ==
Two texts in the PC data were at first found in no dated PC document:
* '''The "swing" clause.''' On [[He's No Jedi]] and [[Jabba, This Is Your Last Chance!]] the data has lightsabers that "may not add to Force drains or 'swing' more than once per battle"; the 2009 sheet, the Master List and the card images say only that they "may not add to Force drains". The clause was later found in the Holotable data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf" /> and on the PC website card list of 21 July 2012, so it is a text the PC published, not a later copying error.<ref name="cl" /> It is the version [[He's No Jedi (Errata)]] and [[Jabba, This Is Your Last Chance! (Errata)]].
* '''The Fleet Security Protocols rewrite.''' The data gives [[Fleet Security Protocols]] a different text ("characters at related starship (or vehicle) sites cumulatively add 2 to your total power..."), where the sheet makes the starship itself "power +2 for each of your characters at its related sites". This text too was in the 2010 Holotable data and on the 2012 card list,<ref name="cdf" /><ref name="cl" /> and is the version [[Fleet Security Protocols (Errata 2)]].
The history article traces both texts to temporary Holotable files built from the PC's text spoilers in August 2009, before the release sheet came out (see [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History#Fleet Security Protocols and He's No Jedi|Fleet Security Protocols and He's No Jedi]]).

== Re-made sheets that keep their first date ==
Three release sheets on the PC's file server are later copies, re-made after errata, although their header still gives the date of the first printing. The dates of the re-makes come from the PDF files' own creation dates.

A sheet of this kind is therefore not a copy of the first printing. For the cards above, the text the sheet shows is an errata version, and the first printing has to be found elsewhere: in a PC news post that quotes the change, in the card list, in a card image, or not at all. No copy of the first Virtual Block 7.3 printing has been found, so the first text of Master Kenobi is reconstructed from the errata post, and the first Virtual Block 8.1 printing of Scoundrel's Luck is lost. By contrast the Virtual Block 7.4 sheet on the server is byte for byte the copy the PC offered for download in February 2012, so it is the first printing.

On these cards the image and sheet text is treated as the original version and the Master List text as a later errata, which is the current text. An image is therefore not proof of a card's current text, and neither is a Master List entry on its own (see [[#The Master List prints older text|above]]). The shields [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]] and [[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Knowledge And Defense (V)]] are a similar case: the sheet and the images allow up to 12 cards under the shield, the Master List 15.

<span id="Errata_marks_that_do_not_match_the_version_(Virtual_Modern)"></span>
== Printed marks and publication images (Virtual Modern) ==
Some [[Virtual Modern]] card images print an errata mark such as E1 or E2. The literal mark and a sequence of published image files identify different things. A change in resolution, layout, orientation or file format does not by itself establish another Errata state. Official alternate-image cards may carry their parent card's existing mark. The [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide|style guide]] distinguishes changed wording and statistics from same-version image formats.<ref name="ht-sla">Players Committee card images in the PC's Holotable image repository: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a324c4e1f244362a7211644a9d5ec6f816d78ccb/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/scomplinkaccess.gif Scomp Link Access (V), July 2024] and [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b3853e63328481978b065262318c0dc4e88b44b6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/scomplinkaccess.gif March 2026]; [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/937f50b401597ac4bd6031307ab412324907e814/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif Passage To The Alderaan System, 25 July 2024] and [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif 30 December 2024].</ref><ref name="vmmarks">Players Committee card images in the PC's Holotable image set ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable swccgpc/holotable], <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1x-*</code>), each version dated by the commit that published it; see the source links on each card article.</ref>

== Captain Needa: printed errata marks ==
The June 2017 partial is [[Captain Needa (Decipher Errata 1998)|image 1]] and prints <code>E</code>. The 2018 full is [[Captain Needa (Decipher Errata 1998)|image 2]] and also prints <code>E</code>. The23 December 2022 face is [[Captain Needa (PC 2023 D-E1 card)|image 3]] and the 19 February 2023 face is [[Captain Needa (PC 2023 D-E1 card)|image 4]]; both print <code>D-E1</code>. Printed marks are retained literally; image sequence does not determine Errata numbering. The 2017 document date and later first repository records do not establish original publication days. June 2017partial: [[File:Dagobah-D-Captain-Needa-June-2017-partial.png|frameless|300px]];2018text: [[File:Captain-Needa-PC-E1-2018-game-text.png|frameless|300px]];2022text: [[File:Captain-Needa-PC-E2-2022-game-text.png|frameless|300px]];2023text: [[File:Captain-Needa-PC-E3-2023-game-text.png|frameless|300px]].

== Flagship image marks ==
The June 2017 partial is [[Flagship (PC Errata 2018 E card)|image 1]] and prints <code>E</code>. The [[Flagship (PC Errata 2018 E card)|2018 full face, image 2]], also prints <code>E</code>. [[Flagship (PC 2023-04 D-E1 card)|March 2023, image 3]], and [[Flagship (PC 2023-06 D-E1 card)|June 2023, image 4]], both print <code>D-E1</code>. [[Flagship (PC 2026 D-E2 card)|July 2026, image 5]], prints <code>D-E2</code>. Image numbers follow dated source records; printed marks are retained without inferring publisher intent. The March face omits “your” from the Alter-immunity sentence, June restores it, and July 2026 changes “If starship lost” to “If starship about to be lost.” Actual original publication days are unknown. June 2017 partial: [[File:Dagobah-D-Flagship-June-2017-partial.png|frameless|300px]]. Later before/after word comparisons remain on each corresponding article.

== E-web Blaster image marks ==
The June 2017 partial is [[E-web Blaster (PC Errata 2018 E card)|image 1]] and prints <code>E</code>. The [[E-web Blaster (PC Errata 2018 E card)|2018 full face, image 2]], and [[E-web Blaster (PC Errata 2021 E card)|2021 full face, image 3]], also print <code>E</code>. The [[E-web Blaster (PC 2023 D-E1 card)|2023 face, image 4]], prints <code>D-E1</code>. Image numbers follow dated source records; printed marks are retained without inferring publisher intent. The 2021 face prints plural “Your warriors present”; the 2017 partial, 2018 full face and 2023 full face use singular “warrior”. Both the 2021 and 2023 full faces show deploy 3 and forfeit 1, as does the original Decipher face. The 2017 partial and 2018 full PC face do not show that sidebar. Actual original publication days are unknown. June 2017 partial: [[File:Hoth-D-E-web-Blaster-June-2017-partial.png|frameless|300px]]. Sidebar in 2018: [[File:E-web-Blaster-2018-07-08-sidebar-detail.png|frameless|150px]]; in 2021: [[File:E-web-Blaster-2021-03-05-sidebar-detail.png|frameless|150px]]; in 2023: [[File:E-web-Blaster-2023-03-02-sidebar-detail.png|frameless|150px]]. Later before/after comparisons remain on their corresponding articles.

== Kessel (Dark) image marks ==
The June 2017 partial is [[Kessel (Dark) (PC Errata 2017 slip)|image 1]] and prints <code>E</code>. The [[Kessel (Dark) (PC Errata 2018 E card)|2018 full image, image 2]], and [[Kessel (Dark) (PC Errata 2018 E card)|2020 full image, image 3]], also print <code>E</code>. Both March 2024 sources — [[Kessel (Dark) (PC 2024 D-E1 card)|image 4]] and [[Kessel (Dark) (PC 2024 D-E1 card)|image 5]] — print <code>D-E1</code>. The source dates are first located records, not established original publication days. Article numbers follow the documented image sequence; actual marks are retained without inferring publisher intent. Full native-orientation before/after faces remain on the corresponding articles, including the two 2024 sources that match pixel-for-pixel after a 180-degree rotation. June 2017 source layout, with its blank artwork window: [[File:Premiere-D-Kessel-June-2017-partial.png|frameless|300px]].

== Smaller slips ==
* '''Typos printed on Alternate Image cards (Virtual Modern, Sets 0–3).''' The PC printed these on its ALT card images and fixed them on a later image; each image is its own version and the wiki shows the words as printed: [[Conquest (V) (ALT)]] lore “Millemium Falcon” (fixed to “Millennium” on [[Conquest (V) (ALT) (Errata)]], 19 February 2023); [[Count Dooku (ALT)]] lore “Serennoian leader” (fixed to “Serennian” on [[Count Dooku (ALT) (Errata)]], 10 August 2022); [[Azure Angel (ALT)]] and [[Azure Angel (ALT)]] concept credit “Original concept by Keivn Shannon” (fixed to “Kevin” on [[Azure Angel (ALT) (Errata)]], 15 January 2022).
* '''A lost clause.''' The front of [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]] reads, on the Virtual Block 8.1 sheet and in the Master List, "While this side up, your Force drains at systems are -1. May use 1 Force to ▲ Imperial Navigation Charts. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen.'"<ref name="vb81" /><ref name="ml" /> The PC card data leaves out the middle sentence and doubles a word: "Flip this card if If Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen'".<ref name="json2026" />
* '''One side copied onto the other.''' [[Rebel Cell - Situation Room]] gives both sides the power bonus on the sheet ("For each of your characters here, your power is +1 at related system").<ref name="vb4" /> In the PC card data the Dark Side text is instead a copy of the Light Side's first sentence, "Deploys only to same planet system as Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site."<ref name="json2026" />
* '''Typos.''' The 2012&ndash;2013 card list has typos found in no other PC document, among them "whever" ([[A Disturbance In The Force (V)]]), "damagethis" ([[Collateral Damage (V)]]), "retireved" ([[Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Card list text)|Away Put Your Weapon (V)]]), "dpeloys" ([[So Be It, Jedi]]), "traget" ([[Evacuate? (V)]]) and "Epic Even" ([[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 2)|Luke, Trust Me]]).<ref name="cl" /> The sheets have their own: the Virtual Block 8.1 sheet's Infiltration says "For reminder of game".<ref name="vb81" /> Card articles on this wiki show each text exactly as published, typos included, and every published text is a version of its card.

== Commence Recharging image mark ==
The third PC image, [[Commence Recharging (Decipher Errata 1998)|Commence Recharging (PC Errata 3)]], prints D-E1. The fourth and fifth PC images, [[Commence Recharging (PC 2023-02 D-E2 card)|Commence Recharging (PC Errata 4)]] and [[Commence Recharging (PC 2023-07 D-E2 card)|Commence Recharging (PC Errata 5)]], both print D-E2. Their numeric printed marks differ from their PC image-version ordinals.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2022-12-23.png|Third PC image]]; [[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2023-02-19.png|Fourth PC image]]; [[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2023-07-03.png|Fifth PC image]].</ref>

[[Commence Recharging (PC 2023-02 D-E2 card)|The 19 February 2023 PC image]] says “If just fired at a planet, Effect is canceled.” [[Commence Recharging (PC 2023-07 D-E2 card)|The 3 July 2023 PC image]] changes “planet” to “system”, but both images print D-E2. The printed mark did not change with that wording. <ref>[[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2023-02-19.png|19 February 2023 image]]; [[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2023-07-03.png|3 July 2023 image]].</ref>

The 2017 composed partial, [[Commence Recharging (Decipher Errata 1998)|Commence Recharging (PC Errata)]], prints unnumbered E. The initial preserved full face, [[Commence Recharging (Decipher Errata 1998)|Commence Recharging (PC Errata 2)]], also prints unnumbered E; neither letter is interpreted as a printed numeric ordinal.<ref>[[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Official PC Decipher Errata sheet]], official text as of 1 June 2017, page 21.</ref>

== Set Your Course For Alderaan digital formula ==
The physical [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]] has the correct +1/or+2 Imperial-or-Super formula. The published [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe (Digital Image)]] prints the incorrect +2/or+1 Victory-class formula. [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe (Digital Image 2)]] is the later corrected full digital design. The rulebook explicitly distinguishes the digital error from all physical copies; neither digital design is called a new physical printing.<ref>[[:File:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], page 152.</ref> Exact lower comparison — incorrect digital: [[File:TA-D-Ultimate-Power-digital-error-lower-native.png|frameless|300px]]; corrected digital: [[File:TA-D-Ultimate-Power-digital-corrected-lower-native.png|frameless|300px]]. Source occurrence dates are first located bounds, not established first publication days.
